subject.title: Feature request: Shareable cron job templates

question: Should ClawHub introduce scheduled-job templates as a fourth first-class artifact family, or standardize them within existing skills or bundle plugins after OpenClaw provides a safe scheduled-job import API?
rationale: Current artifact families intentionally encode different execution and installation semantics, while recurring actions add durable authority that automation cannot define safely.

options.title: Design runtime contract first
options.body: Define OpenClaw validation, preview, consent, permissions, installation, update, disable, and uninstall semantics before choosing the ClawHub representation.

options.title: Use existing families
options.body: Publish cron examples as skills or bundle plugins and avoid a new artifact family unless the existing semantics prove insufficient.

options.title: Add dedicated template family
options.body: Create a fourth moderated family with distinct schema, API, UI, scanning, and installation contracts.

recommendation.title: Design runtime contract first
recommendation.body: Define OpenClaw validation, preview, consent, permissions, installation, update, disable, and uninstall semantics before choosing the ClawHub representation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest concrete history signal spans the package-family, catalog, release, and vision contracts that this decision would change.
